fields.label: Fixed-capacity selection utility
fields.operation_and_denominator: For a predeclared role, pool, outcome `Y`, horizon and capacity `C`: `U(π)=mean(Y among the C people selected by policy π)` or another preregistered consequence-weighted utility. Estimate `U(3×10)`, `Δ_L=U(3×10)-U(longer pipeline)` and `Δ_Q=U(3×10)-U(equal-time comparator)` on the **same held-out pool and C**, with intervals.
fields.source_phase_and_interpretation: E06 independent outcomes; P4 strong-thesis primary. Predeclare absolute floor, non-inferiority margin for `Δ_L` and superiority margin for `Δ_Q`. Incomplete outcomes require a registered missing-label analysis; observed hires alone do not identify full-pool utility.
